test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward score loss
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions with transitions and computing forward score loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear graph with emission weights from a flat vector of log probabilities
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target label sequence and a blank token index
